newsitem.title: USA: Grant sees Q3 revenues less than prior qtr.
newsitem.headline: Grant sees Q3 revenues less than prior qtr.

text.p: Grant Geophysical Inc said Thursday that it expects revenues in the third quarter, ended September 30, to be below those of the $67.2 million recorded in the second quarter as a result of the completion of some contracts in Ecuador. Colombia and the US.

Grant said both Colombian crews completed their assignments in June, and one will start a new project in August while the second is not expected to restart operations until late in the third quarter. One US transition zone crew completed its work in early July and was reassigned to a new project in August. And the company's Ecuadorian operations are also expected to complete their projects during the third quarter and will experience a short period of transition to new contracts.

Grant said that third quarter operating income and operating cash flow will be impacted by the expected reduction in revenues, but that this effect will be mitigated since expenses related to completion of the finished contracts, including the associated demobilization costs of the crews, were accounted for in the second quarter.
The company's backlog is about $54 million, including work extending into early 1998, said Grant.
